title: Issue triage: cv-builder open issues
description: Triage of 3 open issues in Warnes-Innovations/cv-builder: #126 (position style presets, partially implemented), #80 (additional workflow steps, backlog), #60 (in-app persona review, backlog).

items.title: Scope #126 remaining work (position style presets)
items.description: Partial implementation landed in c658590 (domain-aware page warning, estimate-pages fields, layout banner). Remaining: per-session position-style override UI, config.yaml preset storage, style-aware LLM prompt context, master-CV per-section include flags. Decide whether to split remaining scope into sub-issues and set acceptance criteria.
items.resolution: Verified actual implementation state: position-style engine (config.py presets + domain matching), domain-aware page warnings, LLM prompt context, publications-by-style suppression, and per-session override UI are all implemented — more than the issue's last comment indicated. Created 3 sub-issues for truly remaining scope: #131 (config.yaml overrides + medical_clinical/industry_research presets), #132 (master-CV per-section include-by-style flags), #133 (job-intake position-type selector with LLM-inferred confirmation). Added accurate status/remaining-scope comment to #126.

items.title: Assess #80 workflow-step ideas vs #60 overlap
items.description: Issue #80 lists 4 aspirational workflow features (hiring-mgr background, team feedback review, interview prep, differentiation). Item 2 (team/panel feedback review) overlaps #60 persona review. Recommend consolidating #80 into sub-issues or marking it duplicate where it overlaps #60; keep pure ideas backlog.
items.resolution: Verified #80 bundles 4 distinct ideas. Item 3 (interview prep) is partially implemented (backend generates 10 questions via agent_bridge.py/headless_session.py but frontend interview-prep.js is a placeholder). Split into 4 sub-issues: #134 (interview-prep wiring - actionable, recommended priority), #135 (team/panel feedback - overlaps #60), #136 (hiring-manager research - backlog), #137 (differentiation - backlog, partial via persuasion review). Posted triage comment to #80 linking all sub-issues.

items.title: Confirm #60 persona-review scope and priority
items.description: In-app persona review of generated documents. Well-specified, backlog. Duplicate-candidate with #80 item 2. Decide priority vs #126 and #80, and whether to keep as single feature or split personas. No code work yet.
items.resolution: Confirmed #60 scope: in-app generated-document quality persona review (graphical designer/hiring manager/HR-ATS) with structured findings. Decision: keep as single feature, DO NOT merge with #135; #60 builds the persona-review infrastructure (trigger action, personas, structured schema, session persistence, user decision loop) that #135 later reuses for holistic panel mode. No in-app persona backend exists today (only docs + #59 dev-only fixture workflow), so #60 is net-new. Priority: behind #134 (interview-prep wiring, small/shippable with existing backend); ahead of #136/#137. Posted scoping comment to #60.
